categories.strong_mfe: descending 30m short MFE / frozen event-time ATR
categories.strong_mae: descending 30m short MAE / frozen event-time ATR
categories.high_balance: descending rank(two-sided 5m excursion) + inverse-rank(5m 1-second path efficiency)
categories.structure_reversal: ascending trigger-relative first structure-break delay; absolute break timestamp is forbidden as a rank
categories.no_reaction: ascending max(same-session percentile(max(MFE_ATR,MAE_ATR)), same-session percentile(max(MFE_points,MAE_points))) among no-break events

raw_replay_required_checks: 30m raw deadline and last physical seq
5m 1-second path efficiency rebuilt from raw ticks
5m two-sided excursion rebuilt from raw ticks

manual_visual_review.plot_semantics: path-focused y-axis; offscreen frozen references annotated by point distance so distant channel levels cannot flatten the path visually

rejected_sampling_versions.V1: structure cases clustered on one date and no-reaction included horizon-truncated cases
rejected_sampling_versions.V2: structure ranking accidentally used absolute break Unix timestamp instead of trigger-relative delay
rejected_sampling_versions.V3: theoretical session remaining did not guarantee same-contract observation; weekend trading-date attribution and expiry-day contract stop were exposed
rejected_sampling_versions.V4: no-reaction used ATR-normalized movement only and admitted large raw-point moves in very-high-ATR regimes
